dryEvidence.partition: Source/temperature/component-sorted rows with every fifth row held out before fitting.
dryEvidence.use: All remaining rows fit native-plus-RK chemical-potential equality with bounded ridge regression. Held-out rows are evaluated independently and are not claimed as water-bearing validation.
dryEvidence.qualificationDisposition: Dry training and held-out chemical-potential equality RMS values exceed the frozen 0.03 criterion. Dry LLE reproduction therefore fails and remains release-blocking.

waterBearingDevelopmentTopology.use: Only the historical N_T=1 daughter direction is used as a development topology target. The exact parent is reconstructed independently from the declared component masses and molecular weights.
